mapper.sql: select n.notice_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_type, cast(n.notice_content as char) as notice_content, n.status, n.lifecycle_status, n.audience_type, n.scheduled_publish_time, n.published_time, n.expire_time, n.version, n.previous_notice_id, (select count(*) from sys_notice_recipient nr where nr.notice_id = n.notice_id) as recipient_count, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time, n.remark from sys_notice n
mapper.select: select notice_id, notice_title, notice_type, cast(notice_content as char) as notice_content, status, lifecycle_status, audience_type, scheduled_publish_time, published_time, expire_time, version, previous_notice_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, 0 as recipient_count from sys_notice where notice_id = #{noticeId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into sys_notice ( notice_title, notice_type, notice_content, status, lifecycle_status, audience_type, scheduled_publish_time, published_time, expire_time, version, previous_notice_id, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeType}, #{noticeContent}, #{status}, #{lifecycleStatus}, #{audienceType}, #{scheduledPublishTime}, #{publishedTime}, #{expireTime}, #{version}, #{previousNoticeId}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_notice set notice_title = #{noticeTitle}, notice_type = #{noticeType}, notice_content = #{noticeContent}, status = '1', lifecycle_status = 'DRAFT', audience_type = #{audienceType}, scheduled_publish_time = null, published_time = null, expire_time = #{expireTime}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where notice_id = #{noticeId} and lifecycle_status = 'DRAFT' and version = #{version}

update sys_notice set lifecycle_status = #{newLifecycle}, status = #{notice.status}, scheduled_publish_time = #{notice.scheduledPublishTime}, published_time = #{notice.publishedTime}, expire_time = #{notice.expireTime}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{notice.updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where notice_id = #{notice.noticeId} and lifecycle_status = #{expectedLifecycle} and version = #{notice.version}

update sys_notice set lifecycle_status = 'OFFLINE', status = '1', version = version + 1, update_by = 'notice-scheduler', update_time = sysdate() where lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' and expire_time is not null and expire_time <= #{now}
mapper.delete: delete from sys_notice where notice_id = #{noticeId} and lifecycle_status = 'DRAFT'
